title: Book resilience
description: How fast the book refills after a price level is wiped out. A fast recovery means patient liquidity is sitting behind the touch.

state.label: Book state
state.description: Quiet when no level has been depleted lately, recovering while one refills, and depleted if it has not come back. Depleted books move easily.

depletion_side.label: Depleted side
depletion_side.description: Which side of the book last lost half a level, bid or ask. None when nothing has been hit.

recovery_ms.label: Recovery time
recovery_ms.description: How long the last depleted level took to refill to three quarters of its size. Shorter means deeper hidden liquidity.
